card.name: Words before shared-effect terms
card.fires_on: Words like additive, same, similar and sometimes 'and' that sit just before a shared or overlapping item, such as effects with other CNS depressants or similar pharmacology. Mostly in drug interaction text.

modes.label: Additive or similar
modes.description: Words like additive, similar or same that introduce a shared effect or property between drugs or conditions.
